description: Lists the commodities tracked in USDA export sales reporting (wheat, barley, corn, sorghum, soybeans, soybean meal, soybean oil, cotton, rice) with their FAS commodity codes. Use to discover valid `commodity` slugs before calling get_export_sales or get_export_sales_history. Read-only; no API key. Slugs map to FAS 'all' aggregate commodity codes where available.
name: list_esr_commodities
